title: The twelfth fret
summary: Fret 12 is the same note as the open string, one octave higher.

steps.title: Halfway round the circle
steps.body:
Twelve half steps make an octave. So fret 12 on any string plays the same note name as the open string, only higher. Open E becomes E again at fret 12.

**Why it matters:** Fret 12 is a landmark. Many guitars have two dots there to help you find it quickly.

steps.title: Every string repeats at fret 12
steps.body:
The pattern of notes along the neck starts over at fret 12. Whatever you learn between the open string and fret 11 works again after fret 12, one octave higher.

**Why it matters:** You only need to learn half the neck, then use fret 12 to reach the other half.

steps.title: Open and fret 12 on the thin E string
steps.body: The thinnest string is E, and fret 12 of that string is E again, one octave higher.

steps.title: Open and twelve
steps.body: Pluck an open string, then the same string at fret 12. Hear how the two notes sound like the same note, one higher.
